title: Facilities Chemical Intern
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
Join Intel as a Facilities Engineering Undergraduate Intern, where you will contribute to the planning, implementation, and maintenance of building infrastructure and systems. In this role, you'll assist in analyzing operational processes, optimizing energy use, ensuring safety compliance, and supporting facility expansion and layout design. Your work will directly impact Intel's ability to operate efficiently and sustainably, while offering hands-on experience to help build your skills and shape your future career.
Business group
Intel Foundry is at the heart of Intel's mission to deliver world-class silicon manufacturing capabilities and advanced technologies to drive innovation and customer success. As part of the KM1/2 Facilities Operations team, you will support the critical infrastructure that enables our manufacturing sites to operate efficiently, sustainably, and safely. Collaborating with engineering professionals, you'll contribute to ensuring optimal performance and reliability for Intel's global operations.
Key Responsibilities
- Assist in the design, implementation, and maintenance of facility systems, including mechanical, electrical, and chemical processes.
- Analyze operational processes and energy data to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements.
- Support facility expansion projects and contribute to layout optimization, ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations.
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to develop and implement innovative solutions.
- Monitor and maintain facility systems to ensure reliability and performance.
- Document findings, prepare reports, and present recommendations to stakeholders.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Pursuing a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering or a related field.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
- Enthusiasm for developing practical engineering solutions to support growth and innovation.
- Able to commit to a minimum internship period of 5 to 6 months, subject to university/college internship requirements and academic calendar.
We're looking for passionate individuals eager to explore their future careers and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic and inclusive environment. Apply today to take the first step in building your career with Intel. Take the next step in your academic journey by joining Intel's Facilities Operations team, where you will gain practical experience, develop technical expertise, and contribute to meaningful projects that shape Intel's future.
